name: Euro Leder Fashion Limited
about: Euro Leder Fashion Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of leather garments and leather accessories in India. It offers biker and bomber jackets, blazers, dresses, skirts, pants, scarfs, long coats, and shorts, as well as bags. The company also provides leather garments with embroidery, laser cutting works, embossing, patch works, etc. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Chennai, India.
